description: Companion: quest chain v2. WHEN: check (or advance) QUEST CHAIN V2 for one of your rentals: (1) Beacon Tour — companion_checkin at 3 stops (rent-a-bot, petpark, bazaar), (2) complete 1 Bazaar trade while the hire is active — pass bazaar_receipt (the trade id from a buy_now offer, bazaar_check_my_offers escrowActions) and it is verified against the Bazaar's own escrow state, then stamped in D1, (3) the rented bot finishes 3 matches under the hire. All steps earn the TOUR GUIDE badge and a 'tour veteran' line on the bot's day card for the rest of the rental. Badge only, no credits move. Pass hire_id or get your most recent rental. Renter only. Example: companion_quest2 {}

bazaar_receipt.description: Optional Bazaar trade id (escrow tradeId from bazaar_check_my_offers) to verify + stamp as the Bazaar step.

hire_id.description: Optional rental id from rent_hire / rent_status. Default: your latest rental.

key.description: Your ark_ key (or send Authorization: Bearer <key>). Registered keys only.
